allowed_source: Any official GTA VI streamer gameplay ONLY (no reuploads with other creators' watermarks)
logo_rules: If watermark_path is set (e.g., 'assets/campaign_logo.png'), keep visible for 100% of clip duration (0.0s to end). NEVER stretch, recolor, crop, or shrink it (preserve exact aspect ratio). NEVER cover it with captions, hook banner, facecam, or game HUD/minimap.
tier1_only_payout: US, UK, Canada, Australia ONLY (30%+ Tier-1 required on IG; 0.5%+ likes+comments engagement; 100% Western English copy, zero Hindi/Hinglish).
quality_rules: Strong 1-2 second hook, original edit, dynamic word-pop captions, likes publicly visible, keep public for 30+ days, max 5 near-identical clips, NO low-effort raw screen recordings.
safety_filters: Skip isolated GTA 6 story cutscenes/endings (copyright strike risk) and skip loud licensed in-game radio songs (Content ID risk).
